faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Program Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Gandhinagar Program Associate-I recruitment is 12 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Program Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is Graduation or equivalent in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 02 years of post-qualification experience. Additionally, a minimum of 50% in Graduation and 55% in 10th and 12th are necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Program Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Program Associate-I post is 40 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Program Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Program Associate-I position will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 55,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Program Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Program Associate-I post in this recruitment drive by IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IIT Gandhinagar Program Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Program Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Program Associate-I post will involve a Written/Practical Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The recruitment is for a contractual position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Program Associate-I position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIT Gandhinagar or via the "Apply Online" link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.
